Corollary
[compatibility on vector fields]

↗ prop:dc-ch2-3-2

1. ch2:3.3A connection $ abla $ is compatible with the metric if and only if \[ X\langle Y,Z angle =\langle abla _XY,Z angle +\langle Y, abla _XZ angle , \qquad X,Y,Z\in \mathcal{X}(M). ag {4} \]
Proof

\sketch Evaluate (3) at a point along a curve whose velocity there is $X$. This gives (4). Conversely, apply (4) pointwise to the velocity field of a curve to recover (3).

□
